g1.flow: Āl ʿImrān has it twice, both opening inna lladhīna kafarū. 3:10 ends wa ulāʾika hum waqūdu n-nār, fuel for the Fire. 3:116 ends wa ulāʾika aṣḥābu n-nāri hum fīhā khālidūn. Al-Mujādilah keeps that second ending but drops the opening, starting at lan tughniya after the false oath-takers, and says ulāʾika without wa. Hook: fuel, then companions, then the shortened copy.

cues.3:10: After 'Our Lord, You will gather the people for a Day'; ends hum waqūdu n-nār.
cues.3:116: After good deeds never being denied them; ends aṣḥābu n-nāri hum fīhā khālidūn.
cues.58:17: After false oaths used as cover; no opening, starts lan tughniya, and ulāʾika has no wa.
